svg.aria-label: AETHER system architecture, left to right: caller, telephony, speech, interruption classification, deterministic router splitting into a dominant SQLite tool path and a small Gemini fallback, then renderer, Rime TTS and back to the caller, with five generation-fencing checkpoints marked.
svg.text: AETHER — Full-Duplex Multilingual Hotel Voice Agent
Deterministic hotel intelligence with generation-fenced real-time voice execution
only when the router returns nothing — never for a stored fact
— a stale generation must never be spoken
ON THE PHONE AN INTERRUPTION RUNS
No ducking on the phone path: it runs hands-free, so the fence lands at end-of-utterance, not mid-word.
A fenced computation may finish — its result can never be spoken, remembered, resolve “it”, or leave a booking behind.
